meta.title: Creator Kit / interactive explainers
meta.subtitle: Author the facts. Validate the structure. Deliver an explorable diagram.

views.label: 1. Author
views.note: Write typed JSON grounded in the real system. Choose architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow or lifecycle.

views.label: 2. Validate
views.note: Creator verifies the pinned package, rejects remote brand capture, disables update checks and runs Archify delivery checks.

views.label: 3. Explore
views.note: Open the new standalone HTML. Select components, trace relationships and use the guided views. Visual review is still required.

cards.title: Grounded, not inferred
items: JSON describes the authored system; no automatic code analysis.

cards.title: Local generation
items: No API key or cloud inference needed.
The HTML viewer may fetch Google Fonts when opened.

cards.title: Separate from video
items: This artifact is interactive HTML, not an MP4.
HyperFrames and the Studio timeline remain separate workflows.
